name: Rebellion Heroes
original_name: リベリオン・ヒーローズ
source:
In this town, "playing hero" is a popular game.
It is a game of wits and brute force in which the good guys and the bad guys split up to fight for the badge.

Asari Honoka (name can be changed), a high school student who loves Shiba Inu, always plays hero after school with Kiryuu Yamato, a half-human half-Shiba Inu.

This is a coming-of-age story about a pair of students finding their place in the world through playing hero, featuring Shiba Inu.

[translated from [url=https://booth.pm/ja/items/2351965]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
在这个小镇上，“打英雄”是一种流行的游戏。
这是一场斗智斗勇的游戏，好人和坏人分头争夺徽章。

热爱柴犬的高中生浅里穗香（化名）放学后总是和半人半柴犬的桐生大和一起扮演英雄。

这是一个以柴犬为主角的成长故事，讲述了一对学生通过扮演英雄在世界上找到自己的位置的故事。

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/ja/items/2351965]BOOTH[/url]]
